model.fixed_opt_definition: exhaustively best stationary task→agent/effort map over the 10 calibration trajectories; evaluation uses disjoint paired seeds
model.information: all policies observe current task and true current competencies; no future realized demand; ANTICIPATORY knows the declared nonstationary demand law and MIS-v2 parameters
model.reward: per-period capped fraction of the active task requirement; success separately counted; resource use reported, not double-subtracted
